provenance: paper_full_retest_20260923: run_all.py and per-method protocol/run records

cholmod1.label: g2o CHOLMOD kernel / matched Lie-log frontend (1 thread)
cholmod1.objective: 0.5 * full-information chi2; Huber delta 5; hard first-pose gauge; diagonal jitter 1e-10; no outer line search; block ordering and symbolic reuse
cholmod1.caveat: Not stock g2o CLI. Measured archived CHOLMOD had supernodal compiled out. A modern dependency rebuild is not the archived backend and must not be labeled as such. No switch here deliberately disables features of a new backend.

pcg16.label: g2o OpenMP frontend / serial fixed-block PCG (16-worker frontend)
pcg16.objective: Matched full-information Lie-log / Huber delta 5; hard gauge; no CHOLMOD-wrapper jitter
pcg16.timing: solver_wall_sec, including setup and excluding parsing/output
pcg16.caveat: Inner PCG is serial, tolerance 1e-6, absoluteTolerance=false, maxIter=-1 (system dimension). Retain all 20 GN outers; no claim of 16-way PCG.

amm16.label: AMM-PGO / DPGO upstream optimizer with measured parallel-node driver
amm16.objective: Upstream scalar-information chordal Huber loss_reg=25; ignores supplied vertex initialization
amm16.timing: measured algorithm wall = setup + optimization (not reported ideal time / num_nodes)
amm16.caveat: Original per-scene iteration budgets intentionally retained, not newly tuned. Native objective is not the shared full-information Lie-log objective; independent rescore required.

cycle16.label: Cycle-PGO / upstream EC_PGO (16-worker budget)
cycle16.objective: Upstream nonrobust cycle-space objective; no Huber
cycle16.timing: cycle_basis + ordering + solve; optimization + vertex reconstruction also retained separately

historically_unmeasured.Globe100k: Not freshly rerun in September 23 table. Historical OOM label; retained attempt SIGSEGV under 24-GiB address-space cap, not proof of unrestricted physical OOM.

cycle16.caveat: Shared scoring used BFS reconstruction from optimized edges for every scene. Official poses assume consecutive odometry and are insufficient for Cubicle. Offline conversion is not included in native algorithm time.

schwarz16.label: Independent GDSW two-level additive Schwarz-PCG adaptation (16 workers)
schwarz16.objective: Matched full-information Lie-log / Huber delta 5; jitter 1e-10; original line search and early gradient stopping retained
schwarz16.timing: total_sec includes parse/topology/initial objective/solve, matching the reported table; solve_sec is separately recorded and excludes ALL setup

historically_unmeasured.Globe100k: September 23 rerun waived. Located historical timeout was 1800 s; do not relabel as a fresh >2000 s result.

schwarz16.caveat: Independent adaptation of arXiv:2603.08975v2; not official authors' code, and not identical residual/preconditioner settings to the paper.
